# Job Applicant Privacy Notice

## JOB APPLICANT PRIVACY NOTICE – GDPR

**Data Controller:** Litron Lasers Ltd
**Data Protection Officer:** Human Resources Manager
Litron Lasers are committed to ensuring that your privacy is protected. The Job Applicant Privacy
Notice explains what information is collected about you.
As part of any recruitment process, the company collects and processes personal data relating to job
applicants. The company is committed to being transparent about how it collects and uses that data
and to meeting its data protection obligations.

### **What information does the company collect?**

The company collects a range of information about you. This includes:
* * your name, address and contact details, including email address and telephone number;
* details of your qualifications, skills, experience and employment history;
* information about your current level of remuneration, including benefit entitlements;
* whether or not you have a disability for which the company needs to make reasonable adjustments
during the recruitment process;
* information about your entitlement to work in the UK; and
* equal opportunities monitoring information, including information about your ethnic origin,
sexual orientation, health, and religion or belief.

The company collects this information in a variety of ways. For example, data might be contained in
application forms, CVs or resumes, obtained from your passport or other identity documents, or
collected through interviews or other forms of assessment.

The company will also collect personal data about you from third parties, such as references
supplied by former employers. The company will seek information from third parties only once a job
offer to you has been made and will inform you that it is doing so.

Data will be stored in a range of different places, including on your application record, on the HR
management systems and on other IT systems including email.

### **Why does the company process personal data?**

The company needs to process data to take steps at your request prior to entering into a contract
with you.
In some cases, the company needs to process data to ensure that it is complying with its legal
obligations. For example, it is required to check a successful applicant’s eligibility to work in
the UK before employment starts.
The company has a legitimate interest in processing personal data during the recruitment process and
for keeping records of the process. Processing data from job applicants allows the company to manage
the recruitment process, assess and confirm a candidate’s suitability for employment and decide to
whom to offer a job. The company may also need to process data from job applicants to respond to and
defend against legal claims.
The company processes health information if it needs to make reasonable adjustments to the
recruitment process for candidates who have a disability. This is to carry out its obligations and
exercise specific rights in relation to employment.
Where the company processes other special categories of data, such as information about ethnic
origin, sexual orientation, health or religion or belief, this is for equal opportunities monitoring
purposes.
The company will not use your data for any purpose other than the recruitment exercise for which you
have applied.

### **Who has access to data?**

Your information will be shared internally for the purposes of the recruitment exercise. This
includes the HR and recruitment team, interviewers involved in the recruitment process, and managers
in the business area with a vacancy.
The company will not share your data with third parties, unless your application for employment is
successful and it makes you an offer of employment.
The company will not transfer your data outside the European Economic Area.

### **How does the company protect data?**

The company takes the security of your data seriously. It has internal policies and controls in
place to ensure that your data is not lost, accidentally destroyed, misused or disclosed, and is not
accessed except by authorised employees in the proper performance of their duties.

### **For how long does the company keep data?**

If your application for employment is unsuccessful, the company will hold your data on file for 6
months after the end of the relevant recruitment process. If you agree to allow the company to keep
your personal data on file, the company will hold your data for a fixed period for consideration for
future employment opportunities. At the end of that period or once you withdraw your consent, your
data is deleted or destroyed.
If your application for employment is successful, personal data gathered during the recruitment
process will be transferred to your personnel file and retained during your employment. The periods
for which your data will be held will be provided to you in a new employee privacy notice.

### **Your rights**

As a data subject, you have a number of rights. You can:
* access and obtain a copy of your data on request;
* require the company to change incorrect or incomplete data;
* require the company to delete or stop processing your data, for example where the data is no
longer necessary for the purposes of processing;
* object to the processing of your data where the company is relying on its legitimate interests as
the legal ground for processing; and
* ask the company to stop processing data for a period if data is inaccurate or there is a dispute
about whether or not your interests override the company’s legitimate grounds for processing data.

If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact the Data Protection Officer, HR
department, [HR@litron.co.uk][39] . You can make a subject access request by completing the
company’s form for making a subject access request.

If you believe that the company has not complied with your data protection rights, you can complain
to the Information Commissioner. [https://ico.org.uk][40] .

### **What if you do not provide personal data?**

You are under no statutory or contractual obligation to provide data to the company during the
recruitment process. However, if you do not provide the information, the company may not be able to
process your application properly or at all. For example, if we require a right to work in UK check
or references for this role and you fail to provide us with relevant details, we will not be able to
take your application further.

You are under no obligation to provide information for equal opportunities monitoring purposes and
there are no consequences for your application if you choose not to provide such information.

# Find Us

## By Car:

Leave the M6 Motorway at junction 1 then take the A426 toward Rugby
Please follow this link for road maps. [MULTIMAP.COM][39]

## By Air:

Litron can be reached via 3 main airports.

**[Birmingham International Airport][40]:** 30 minutes drive or 30 mins by train.
**[London Stansted Airport][41]:** 2 hours drive – no direct train.
**[London Heathrow][42]:** 1.5 Hours drive – no direct train.

## By Train:

Rugby can be reached from either London Euston station or Birmingham International station. Trains
take approximately 1 hour and 45 minutes and 45 minutes respectively.

Please visit the [National Rail website][43] for more information and departure times.

# Spares & Consumables

**Litron offer only original spare parts of the highest quality.**
All parts are tested in our laboratories and must meet the same high standards as parts being
assembled into new lasers. This quality assurance can only be offered by Litron original parts.

Typical consumables include:

• Flashlamps [(safety information)][39]
• Deionisation cartridges
• Water filters for chillers and coolers.

Please contact [service@litron.co.uk][40] listing your requirement. Alternatively, you can order
spares and replacement parts via your local [Litron Lasers distributor][41].

*When enquiring please ensure you state the model and serial no. of your laser which is located on
the rear plate of the laser head.*

# Warranty & Shipping Policy

**Litron Lasers Ltd. RMA (Return to Manufacturer Authorisation) Policy**
Please read the RMA Policy and follow the instructions set out below.

**Do not send products of any kind to Litron Lasers Ltd if they do not have an authorised RMA number
displayed on the package.**
Goods received without an RMA number may be refused by the receiving department and may be returned
at your expense. All instructions relating to the return of your item are detailed below.

**Obtaining an RMA number**
1. Please fill out and submit the online RMA form which can be found
at:[www.litronlasers.com/services/rma-form/][39] If for any reasons you have problems doing this
please contact Litron Lasers directly at +44 (0) 1788 574444/ [service@litron.co.uk][40].
2. If you have been discussing a service case with Litron and we have not been able to resolve the
problem remotely, you will have already been given a case reference number. This is your RMA number.
You may return the products using this number if advised to do so by Litron. In this case you will
not need to complete the online RMA form as we will already have the details.

**Return to Litron Warranty
**Litron Lasers Ltd. offers a **Return to Litron Warranty.
**If your system is within warranty then any valid repairs will be carried out at no cost to you. We
will inspect the laser and if in our opinion the warranty has been invalidated in any way, we will
inform you of this immediately and of any associated repair costs. Should chargeable repair work be
required, we will not commence any work in the absence of a corresponding purchase order. Should you
choose not to have the repair work carried out we reserve the right to charge an inspection fee for
the initial assessment payable prior to the return shipment of the laser (£650.00) If you choose to
have the system repaired pursuant to any quotation we will require an updated purchase order to
reflect the quoted cost of repair prior to commencing any repair work. For warranty repairs you
should organise shipment of goods to Litron Lasers Ltd using your chosen freight forwarder. All
shipping costs for returning goods should be covered by the customer. Litron will return the goods
to the Customer freight prepaid. All duties and taxes are to be paid locally by the customer.

**Return to Litron Non Warranty**
If your system is no longer covered by a warranty or any part of the warranty has expired, you will
need to supply a purchase order to cover the initial assessment of the system (£650.00). We must
have the Purchase Order for the inspection of the system BEFORE we commence any assessment.
Following assessment Litron will provide you with service report and full quotation for the cost of
the repair. Litron will not commence any repairs or replace any components without receipt of a
corresponding purchase order.

**RMA Repair Warranty
**All items repaired by Litron Lasers Ltd are warranted for a period of 90 days. This period applies
only to the repaired item whether the system was under warranty or not. Systems repaired under
warranty keep the original warranty period or 90 days, whichever is longer.

**Warranty replacement parts
**It is our policy to receive the defective part at Litron for assessment prior to any replacement
part being sent. In emergency situations, and on a discretionary basis, we may ship a replacement
part prior to receiving the defective part. Any emergency shipment requires a company purchase order
for the value of the replacement part prior to shipment. Failure to receive the defective part
within thirty (30) days of shipment of the replacement part will result in Litron Lasers invoicing
against the purchase order for the full list price of the part shipped plus shipping
costs. *Emergencies are handled on an individual basis and require interaction with a Litron Laser’s
technical support representative.*

**Shipping Policy**
**IN ALL CASES** Customers must obtain an RMA number prior to the return of any products. All
systems shipped to Litron Lasers Ltd must be **shipped with incoterm DAP** with the RMA number
clearly indicated on the shipping label and on the waybill. Shipments which arrive **without** an
RMA number may be **refused** and returned to the Customer at Customer’s expense.

Proper packaging must be used on all return shipments. The Customer is liable for any damage
incurred in transit and will be charged if new shipping materials are required for the return
shipment.

**Domestic Shipments procedure:
**1. Obtain a valid RMA number.
2. Return the item to Litron DAP.
3. For warranty repairs Litron will return the item to the Customer freight prepaid. All duties and
taxes paid locally by the customer.
4. For non-warranty repairs Litron will either return the item prepaid and add the shipping costs to
the invoice or inform the customer that the item is ready such that they can arrange their own
collection. Preference needs to be specified on the PO for repair.

**EU and International Shipments procedure:
**1. Obtain a valid RMA number.
2. Return the item to Litron DAP.
3. For warranty repairs Litron will return the item to the Customer freight prepaid.
4. For non-warranty repairs Litron will either return the item prepaid and add the shipping costs to
the invoice or inform the customer that the item is ready such that they can arrange their own
collection. Preference needs to be specified on the PO for repair.
5. On **ALL** international returns for both warranty and non-warranty items the customer is
responsible for any duties, brokers fees or freight charges chargeable when goods are received
following repair.
6. If you have a dedicated broker that handles your shipments then please provide full details
including contact name, contact number, address and email address. This information can then be
included on the shipping documents and prevent any clearance complications.
7. All return shipments must be shipped with a commercial invoice and packing list. Your commercial
invoice should include the following information:
* Description of the goods:
* Serial Number:
* Origin of goods:
* Value for customs:
* Commodity code/HS code:
* RMA number:
* Number of boxes/crates:
* Weight and dimensions of the box/crate(s)
* Incoterms: DAP
* EORI number: (EU only)

Please contact Litron [service@litron.co.uk][41] if you are unsure of any of the details required
for the commercial invoice.

***Commodity code***

**It is important that you use the correct commodity code/HS code for your goods. The commodity code
for laser systems is 90132000. **

**RMA SHIPPING INSTRUCTIONS**

**RMA Return Instructions
Include the following:**
1. RMA number
2. A commercial invoice (international shipments only) and packing list
3. Any other relevant information
4. PO for the inspection fee as advised (Non-warranty shipments) – £650.00
5. Clear identification of sender (include address, contact name, telephone number and email
address)
6. Provide Litron with full return address, contact name, telephone number and email address
7. Confirm to Litron the return shipping method for non-warranty shipments (whether it is courier
account, preferred service or if Litron is to organise shipping and include the charge on the
invoice)

**LABELLING THE BOX**
Make sure that the RMA number is plainly visible on the outside of the package you are sending. Any
packages without RMA numbers visible on the outside of the package may be refused. Please use the
following address for shipping RMA items to Litron.

Litron Lasers Ltd
RMA number ________________
8 Consul Road
Rugby
Warwickshire CV21 1PB
England

**By submitting an RMA request form you are deemed to have read and accepted these terms and
conditions.**

**PACKAGING**
Make sure the product is securely and safely packaged in its original packaging or in similar
suitable packaging. It is the customer’s responsibility to ensure that the system is safely and
suitable packaged. Goods should not be able to slide or tip inside the packaging. We recommend
attaching a ShockWatch and TiltWatch label to your packaging. Systems damaged due to inadequate
packaging are not covered by warranty. If you need any advice on packing or packaging materials then
please contact [service@litron.co.uk][42]

**Wooden Packaging Guidelines: IPPC- GB-FC124 HT**
All wood packaging used for returning lasers or components to Litron UK must use meet ISPM15
international standards. Only compliant and suitably marked wood packaging materials should be used.
Failure to use compliant and suitably marked wood packaging may result in the shipment being stopped
at UK Customs and returned to you at your cost. Litron accepts no liability or responsibility for
any costs or consequential costs resulting from the use of non-compliant and suitably marked wood
packaging. In compliance with UK legislation, any wood packaging materials that are found to have
any form of infestation will be destroyed by burning and new crates will be charged to you for the
return shipment.

**All Litron supplied wooden shipping crates use IPPC- GB-FC124 HT and are compliant and marked
packaging and must be retained for future use.**

[Here is the link to the HMRC website about ISPM15][43]

***It says:****
Requirements for imports using wood packaging If the goods you import are to be packed in wooden
packaging, you should check that the packaging is compliant with ISPM15. There are no tests that
show whether wood has been properly treated. The presence of any living insects in the wood can be
taken to mean that it wasn’t treated and any wood packaging material with living insects must not be
re-used but should be destroyed (or treated by an approved facility and re-marked).*

**Dunnage**
Dunnage may be used with cargos of sawn wood (e.g. in the form of bearers, stickers, spacers etc).
Only dunnage that meets the requirements of ISPM15 is allowed to enter the UK. Material that is not
ISPM15 compliant could be destroyed by burning or re-exported.

*However, dunnage such as bearers, stickers and spacers which are integrated or banded into cargoes
of regulated wood does not need to be marked to ISPM15 standards because the phytosanitary
certificate will cover the whole consignment. For bearers and stickers etc. made from
non-manufactured wood products and greater than 6 millimetres thickness which are integrated or
banded into cargoes of non-regulated wood – e.g. tropical hardwoods, plywood and other wood panel
products – as well as all dunnage associated with any other type of cargo, must be ISPM15 compliant
and marked, regardless of whether they are a regulated species or not.*

# Press Releases

**SYSTEMATIC Growth and NILARIO Partner with the owners of LITRON to Accelerate Growth**

24/11/25— Litron today announced a strategic partnership with Nilario, a newly established platform
focused on building a group of like-minded, entrepreneur-led companies within precision measurement
technologies. Nilario was formed in 2024 by Systematic Growth, a Scandinavian investment firm based
in Stockholm with the ambition to create groups of companies that become market leaders within their
niches. This partnership marks an important milestone for both Litron and Systematic Growth,
reflecting the significant growth potential and market opportunities ahead for Litron.

**About Systematic Growth and Nilario**

Systematic Growth is a partner-owned investment company, where the team itself together is the
largest contributor of funds, resulting in strong alignment with the companies and entrepreneurs
they support. The firm has a 15-year track record of partnering with entrepreneur-led businesses to
build larger platforms in markets with structural growth. Their strategy is centered on combining
complementary companies capable of collaborating to deliver enhanced value to customers. Over this
period, Systematic Growth has successfully built 12 platforms using this approach.

A defining feature of Systematic Growth’s model is its de-centralised platform structure. Companies
joining a platform retain their autonomy, with decision-making and strategic direction kept close to
customers.

**Commitment to Continuity and Quality**

Litron’s owners will continue in their roles in the company and become significant shareholders in
Nilario. There will be no changes to Litron’s day-to-day operations, brand, location, staff, or
management team. Litron will continue to serve all customers with the same high levels of quality
and service for which the company is known. The partnership will not alter Litron’s core strategy
going forward.

# Careers

# Careers at Litron Lasers

Litron is all about its people; our great people make us a great company. We are a vibrant company
seeking motivated people looking to develop their careers in the fast-growing international laser
industry. We encourage an open and flexible team atmosphere that promotes innovation and continuous
improvement. Our success is built on the outstanding abilities of our people right across the
business from Research & Development and manufacturing to support and sales.

If you are looking for a career that will really challenge and empower you, whilst providing rewards
for success, then Litron could just be the perfect choice.

# Opportunities and careers at Litron Lasers

Litron Lasers is one of the world’s leading solid state laser manufacturers. Our lasers find
widespread use in a multitude of scientific and industrial applications worldwide.

Based in Rugby, England, we are a vibrant company seeking motivated people looking to develop their
careers in the fast growing international laser industry.

As part of Litron’s continued expansion and growth we are looking for exceptional individuals to
join our established research & development, laser test, electrical & mechanical engineering and
sales teams.

Litron designs and manufacturers all aspects of its products in-house and with an expanding product
range there are a number of exciting vacancies available to the right candidates.

*Litron Lasers operates an equal opportunity policy and welcomes applications from people of all
diverse backgrounds.*

# Press Releases

**SYSTEMATIC Growth and NILARIO Partner with the owners of LITRON to Accelerate Growth**

24/11/25— Litron today announced a strategic partnership with Nilario, a newly established platform
focused on building a group of like-minded, entrepreneur-led companies within precision measurement
technologies. Nilario was formed in 2024 by Systematic Growth, a Scandinavian investment firm based
in Stockholm with the ambition to create groups of companies that become market leaders within their
niches. This partnership marks an important milestone for both Litron and Systematic Growth,
reflecting the significant growth potential and market opportunities ahead for Litron.

**About Systematic Growth and Nilario**

Systematic Growth is a partner-owned investment company, where the team itself together is the
largest contributor of funds, resulting in strong alignment with the companies and entrepreneurs
they support. The firm has a 15-year track record of partnering with entrepreneur-led businesses to
build larger platforms in markets with structural growth. Their strategy is centered on combining
complementary companies capable of collaborating to deliver enhanced value to customers. Over this
period, Systematic Growth has successfully built 12 platforms using this approach.

A defining feature of Systematic Growth’s model is its de-centralised platform structure. Companies
joining a platform retain their autonomy, with decision-making and strategic direction kept close to
customers.

**Commitment to Continuity and Quality**

Litron’s owners will continue in their roles in the company and become significant shareholders in
Nilario. There will be no changes to Litron’s day-to-day operations, brand, location, staff, or
management team. Litron will continue to serve all customers with the same high levels of quality
and service for which the company is known. The partnership will not alter Litron’s core strategy
going forward.

# Our History

Founded in 1998, NP Photonics develops and manufactures specialty fiber lasers, fiber amplifiers and
transport fibers for the near- and mid-infrared (IR) wavelength bands. Our proprietary fiber
technology is used across a broad family of products, including narrow linewidth, low phase-noise
fiber lasers designed for operation in industrial environments.

Our core strengths are technology innovation, product development, quality engineering and
manufacturing world-class products for applications in sensing, defense, metrology and research.

We currently have over 1,400 lasers installed worldwide, and we continue to grow through technology
development, strategic partnerships and engagement with markets in which the company has a clear
sustainable advantage.

# Our History

Founded in 1998, NP Photonics develops and manufactures specialty fiber lasers, fiber amplifiers and
transport fibers for the near- and mid-infrared (IR) wavelength bands. Our proprietary fiber
technology is used across a broad family of products, including narrow linewidth, low phase-noise
fiber lasers designed for operation in industrial environments.

Our core strengths are technology innovation, product development, quality engineering and
manufacturing world-class products for applications in sensing, defense, metrology and research.

We currently have over 1,400 lasers installed worldwide, and we continue to grow through technology
development, strategic partnerships and engagement with markets in which the company has a clear
sustainable advantage.

# DRIVING EVEN FASTER DATACOM

See why the rapid growth in AI/ML is driving a demand for faster datacom enabled by innovative
Coherent solutions.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

# DRIVING EVEN FASTER DATACOM

See why the rapid growth in AI/ML is driving a demand for faster datacom enabled by innovative
Coherent solutions.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

### Automotive & Energy Solutions

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

### Instrumentation

See how we’re helping professionals and institutions — from research facilities and OEMs to
hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][66]

# Services

# Design and Prototyping Services

## Harness Our Technical Expertise

Whether it is mechanical, software, or electrical, engage with our expert engineering teams.
SemQuest is ready to assist your project with our design services in the Colorado area or around the
world.

[Contact Us][17]

## Mechanical Engineering

At SemQuest, we’ve solved some highly challenging engineering problems for the DoD. In addition to
making high tech diagnostic equipment for the DoD, we’ve had to tackle the problem of integrating
our equipment to various flight, ground, and maritime platforms. Our experienced team is ready to
provide you comprehensive mechanical engineering solutions tailored to meet your unique needs. From
concept development to prototyping and testing, we ensure that every project is executed with
precision and efficiency. Whether you require assistance with product design, structural analysis,
or manufacturing processes, we are here to help you turn your ideas into reality.

## Software & Electrical Engineering

In today’s digital age, robust software solutions are essential for business success. Our software
development team at SemQuest is dedicated to creating custom applications that enhance operational
efficiency and drive innovation. We offer a full range of services, including software design,
development, integration, and maintenance. Our agile approach ensures that we remain responsive to
your needs, delivering high-quality software in alignment with your business objectives. Let us help
you harness the power of technology to streamline your processes and improve your bottom line.

## Research and Development

Innovation is at the heart of what we do at SemQuest. Our research and development services are
designed to push the boundaries of technology and engineering. We collaborate closely with our
clients to explore new ideas, conduct feasibility studies, and develop cutting-edge solutions that
address complex challenges. Our nimble and multidisciplinary team combines expertise in mechanical
engineering and software development to create integrated solutions that drive progress and foster
growth. Rapid prototyping and development that **works** is our specialty. Tap into our capability
to help stay ahead of the competition and bring your visionary projects to life.

## Work With Us

Whether your organization is in Colorado like us or elsewhere, reach out if our engineering services
can be of use to you!

precision and efficiency. Whether you require assistance with product design, structural analysis,
or manufacturing processes, we are here to help you turn your ideas into reality.

At SemQuest, we’ve solved some highly challenging engineering problems for the DoD. In addition to

# About Techwin

Leading provider of advanced solid-state and fiber laser technologies for scientific, industrial,
and defense applications worldwide.

## Our Mission

Techwin is committed to providing stable, reliable, and cost-effective laser sources for atmospheric
lidar, biomedical applications, laser spectroscopy, cold atom physics, and quantum physics fields.

We have deep cooperation with well-known research institutions and industry users both domestically
and internationally, conducting custom development of laser-related technologies and systems as well
as batch production of products.

[Techwin Technology]

## R&D Focus Areas

Our key research and development directions

### Advanced Solid-State Laser Technologies

Seed injection, MOPA amplification, fiber+solid hybrid amplification, side-pumped amplification,
slab amplification, etc.

### High-Power Single-Frequency Fiber Lasers

Narrow linewidth seed source + high-power fiber amplification technology for exceptional
performance.

### Efficient Nonlinear Frequency Conversion

PPLN single-pass frequency doubling, LBO/KTP double/triple frequency doubling, Raman, OPO/OPA
technologies.

### Laser Electronics & Opto-Mechanical Integration

Temperature control, driving, timing, optical power monitoring electronics modules and optical
communication systems.

### Optoelectronic Engineering & Process Optimization

Long lifespan, small size, good environmental adaptability, and advanced process research.

### Global Collaboration

Collaborating with international institutions and industry leaders to drive innovation and solve
complex challenges.

# About Techwin

Leading provider of advanced solid-state and fiber laser technologies for scientific, industrial,
and defense applications worldwide.

## Our Mission

Techwin is committed to providing stable, reliable, and cost-effective laser sources for atmospheric
lidar, biomedical applications, laser spectroscopy, cold atom physics, and quantum physics fields.

We have deep cooperation with well-known research institutions and industry users both domestically
and internationally, conducting custom development of laser-related technologies and systems as well
as batch production of products.

[Techwin Technology]

## R&D Focus Areas

Our key research and development directions

### Advanced Solid-State Laser Technologies

Seed injection, MOPA amplification, fiber+solid hybrid amplification, side-pumped amplification,
slab amplification, etc.

### High-Power Single-Frequency Fiber Lasers

Narrow linewidth seed source + high-power fiber amplification technology for exceptional
performance.

### Efficient Nonlinear Frequency Conversion

PPLN single-pass frequency doubling, LBO/KTP double/triple frequency doubling, Raman, OPO/OPA
technologies.

### Laser Electronics & Opto-Mechanical Integration

Temperature control, driving, timing, optical power monitoring electronics modules and optical
communication systems.

### Optoelectronic Engineering & Process Optimization

Long lifespan, small size, good environmental adaptability, and advanced process research.

### Global Collaboration

Collaborating with international institutions and industry leaders to drive innovation and solve
complex challenges.

# AQNL Series Sub-Nanosecond Lasers

The AQNL series sub-nanosecond lasers deliver output pulse widths of < 2 ns while maintaining
excellent beam quality. The timing jitter between the optical output signal and the trigger signal
is less than 1 ns. Maximum output energy can reach 20 mJ, and the wavelength can be extended to 532
nm, 355 nm, and other bands. This product series features excellent beam quality, high peak power,
reliable performance, compact structure, and easy operation and maintenance. Combined with advanced
manufacturing processes, it can meet the requirements of harsh operating environments such as
airborne, vehicle-mounted, and high-/low-temperature conditions.

Get Quote Now

### Key Features
* High peak power
* Minimum pulse width down to 800 ps
* Burrfree pulse waveform
* Mature technology, stable and reliable

### Applications
* Atmospheric lidar
* Marine detection lidar
* Laser ultrasonics
* Singlephoton detection

# Integrated Frequency-Stabilized and Frequency-Shifted Light Source

The Fre-Lock & Shift integrated light source is widely utilized in laser wind LiDAR, precision
spectroscopy, sensing, and metrology. The system architecture consists of the Fre-Lock stabilization
module and the optional Fre-Shift frequency-shifting module. Frequency Stabilization Module
(Fre-Lock) Designed for precise laser frequency locking, the Fre-Lock module features a modular
architecture that integrates a narrow-linewidth laser, a gas absorption optical path, and feedback
electronics. It supports both Absorption Edge Midpoint Locking and PDH (Pound-Drever-Hall) Locking,
delivering a frequency-stable seed laser output at the hundred-milliwatt level. Frequency Shifting
Module (Fre-Shift) — Optional Working in tandem with the stabilization module, the Fre-Shift module
enables frequency shifting based on a stabilized frequency. It offers a maximum shifting range of
3.5 GHz with an accuracy of 2 MHz. The module integrates high-precision seed driver temperature
control, a digital frequency-phase discriminator, and loop filters. It supports LD
current/temperature PID feedback control, multi-channel AD acquisition, and DA output. Core
Technology: Iodine Molecular Absorption Edge Stabilization The system locks to the midpoint of
iodine absorption line edges. By utilizing a high-speed FPGA feedback control module, three-stage
stabilization loop control, and optical power feedback technology, it ensures long-term,
high-stability laser output. The host computer software stores parameters for various absorption
lines, allowing seamless switching between Lines 1104-1111. The system features an automatic
re-locking function in case of accidental de-locking, and supports manual or automatic calibration
of the stabilized wavelength at any time. The Fre-Lock & Shift integrated light source is
structurally stable and highly reliable, ensuring reliable 24/7 long-term operation.

* Integrated frequency stabilization and frequency shifting
* Absorptionedge midpoint locking and PDH locking support
* Optional frequency shift up to 3.5 GHz with 2 MHz accuracy
* FPGAbased multistage frequency control loops
* Optical power feedback for longterm stability

* Doppler wind lidar

# SPFL Series 1550 nm Single-Frequency Pulsed Fiber Lasers

The SPFL series lasers are divided into two models based on single-pulse energy (10 μJ and 300 μJ):
SPFL-10 and SPFL-300. This series is specifically developed for coherent Doppler wind lidar
applications, operating in an eye-safe laser wavelength band with a near Fourier-transform-limited
spectrum. The laser repetition rate, pulse width, and waveform are adjustable, meeting system
requirements such as different range resolutions and wind-speed measurement accuracies.
High-precision low-noise current driving and temperature control, high-speed pulse waveform
pre-shaping, suppression of fiber nonlinear optical effects, and spectral noise suppression ensure
high output spectral signal-to-noise ratio, smooth and editable waveforms, and high single-pulse
energy. The low-power-consumption design supports long-term outdoor operation under harsh
environmental conditions.

Get Quote Now

### Key Features
* Singlepulse energy: 10 / 300 μJ
* Adjustable pulse width
* Linewidth as low as 1 kHz
* High polarization extinction ratio, high spectral signaltonoise ratio, and excellent beam quality

### Applications
* Coherent Doppler wind lidar
* Atmospheric environmental laser remote sensing
* Wind resource assessment and surveying
* Aerodynamics and environmental science research

# SCSL-Type NPRO Lasers

The SCSL-type Non-Planar Ring Oscillator (NPRO) lasers use a single laser crystal combined with an
external magnetic field to form a unidirectional non-planar ring cavity (Non-Planar Ring Oscillator,
NPRO). This design enables narrow linewidth (kHz level), low noise, and high frequency stability,
delivering continuous-wave single-frequency laser output. Thanks to reliable packaging technology,
long-term aging tests, and extensive system-level validation, this series of lasers offers excellent
stability, high reliability, and outstanding performance. The NPRO lasers feature a spectral
linewidth of <5 kHz and a relative intensity noise (RIN) below −140 dB/Hz at 10 MHz. This
performance is achieved through a highly stable internal oscillator and dedicated low-noise
electronics, which effectively suppress laser self-excited relaxation oscillations.

# NPFL Series Nanosecond Pulsed Fiber Laser

The NPFL series nanosecond pulsed fiber lasers feature ultra-high repetition rates (up to MHz,
adjustable), high peak power, and nanosecond-level pulse widths (pulse width adjustable). Technical
features include a master oscillator power amplifier (MOPA) architecture based on “narrow-spectrum
semiconductor laser diode direct pulse modulation + multi-stage fiber amplification,” enabling
single-pulse energies up to 100 μJ. The product is compact, mature, and reliable, operating in an
eye-safe wavelength band. It is widely used in applications such as 3D imaging and mapping LiDAR,
single-photon ranging and imaging, and mid-infrared supercontinuum generation

Get Quote Now

### Key Features
* Adjustable pulse width and repetition rate
* Singlepulse energy up to 100 μJ
* Polarizationmaintaining / nonpolarizationmaintaining options
* Compact structure

### Applications
* Mapping and imaging LiDAR
* Singlephoton ranging and imaging
* Midinfrared supercontinuum radiation

## HeCd gas laser vs. DPSS laser

Looking to replace your helium cadmium laser with an efficient, high power DPSS laser alternative?

Benefit from up to 4x more usable power, stable and reliable output, and a high quality beam without
mode cleaning.

The Skylark 320 is designed to replace HeCd lasers in applications across:
* Laser interference lithography
* UV Raman spectroscopy
* Photoluminescence

## Upgrade your UV workhorse

Helium Cadmium (HeCd) lasers have long served the demand for ultraviolet wavelengths at 325 nm — but
are now outclassed by a diode-pumped solid-state laser alternative.

Upgrading from a 325 nm HeCd to a 320 nm Skylark DPSS laser offers four times more power, improved
stability, lower maintenance, and a cleaner spectral performance within a compact, solid-state laser
platform that is ready for integration into both research and industrial environments. Discover [6
reasons to consider replacing your HeCd system with a DPSS laser][47] on our blog.

## Four times more usable power

The Skylark 320 nm DPSS laser delivers up to four times the output power of a typical 325 nm HeCd
system.

Higher power translates to shorter processing times, higher throughput, and improved signal strength
in UV-sensitive materials and processes.

## Long term stability

HeCd lasers are prone to power drift and thermal instability, which can affect repeatability and
accuracy in precision applications.

The Skylark 320 offers wavelength stability of ± 0.2 pm and power stability within ± 2% over 10s of
hours, maintaining consistent illumination and spectral performance over extended operation.

## Spectral purity

The Skylark 320 laser operates in a single frequency, TEM₀₀ mode with M² ≤ 1.1, delivering a clean
Gaussian beam and ultra-narrow linewidth: < 1 GHz vs. < 0.00005 GHz.

This produces stable interference fringes, uniform illumination, and excellent spatial coherence,
improving feature uniformity in lithography and data quality in spectroscopy.

## Low maintenance, compact design

DPSS lasers often have a longer lifetime and double the maintenance interval of gas lasers,
significantly reducing downtime and operational disruption. Paired with long-term stability, DPSS
lasers also offer increased reliability that makes them ideal for industrial customers seeking to
reduce time and resources spent on reactive maintenance.

### SKYLARK LASERS

# Laser manufacturer of spectrally pure, high performance CW single frequency DPSS lasers

Our single frequency laser systems are precision engineered under Class 5 cleanroom conditions at
our headquarters in Edinburgh, Scotland.

We work collaboratively with our customers and research partners to understand their needs and
tailor our lasers to their application – helping reveal the unseen, detect the imperceptible, and
measure the unknown.

## Skylark Lasers origin

The skylark is a remarkable species distinguished by its ability to maintain a sustained, controlled
ascent while producing a pure, uninterrupted song. This mirrors the core engineering philosophy of
our lasers: continuous, stable operation over an extended lifetime.

With Skylark Lasers, you get more than a beam of light — you get a commitment to precision,
stability, and spectral purity.

Established in 2013 with a focus on the R&D of uncommon and hard-to-reach wavelengths, Skylark
Lasers now deliver commercial systems trusted by leading researchers and OEMs worldwide.

## Core values

Our core values guide how we innovate, collaborate, and grow. We are driven by ambition to tackle
the toughest challenges, and by innovation to uncover new possibilities through leading-edge laser
technology. With collaboration, we build strong partnerships that transform ideas into real-world
solutions. And through continuous learning, we nurture a growth mindset that keeps us curious,
adaptable, and always moving forward.

##### Ambition

Our team pursues the challenge of developing spectrally pure laser technology to enable the world’s
most demanding and cutting-edge applications – reducing cost, weight, and size while maximising
power and performance.

##### Innovation

We develop and commercialise reliable, long lifetime lasers with the purest spectral properties that
enable customers to reveal the unseen, detect the imperceptible, and measure the unknown.

##### Collaboration

We work with our customers and partners to gain a deep understanding of their needs - connecting the
dots between lasers and application to deliver tailored solutions.

##### Continuous learning

Embodying a growth mindset, we value continuous learning and thrive in an environment of curiosity
and exploration.

## Skylark Lasers team

##### Executive Chairman

##### Ewan McLellan

Deeply embedded in the start-up and scale-up ecosystem since 2008, Ewan serves in pivotal roles
ranging from CEO to Chair. An engineer by training, his leadership experience spans across
nanomaterials and advanced engineering. Since 2020, he has Chaired Skylark Lasers, guiding the
company through strategic milestones and positioning it for long-term success.

##### Non-Executive Director

##### Mark Hanson

Mark brings a wealth of experience working for entrepreneurial technology companies, holding various
management and leadership positions across global R&D, procurement, engineering, and commercial
development. At Skylark Lasers, Mark drives the company’s commercial strategy, leveraging his broad
expertise to deliver sustainable growth and customer success.

##### CEO

##### Chris Madin

Chris brings over 20 years of leadership experience in the photonics and laser instrumentation
industry, and extensive experience in building global sales channels, managing new product
development, and driving operational excellence in high growth photonics environments with customers
across semiconductor inspection and life science instrumentation.

##### CTO

##### Michael Summers

Michael has over 20 years of experience leading the delivery of complex optoelectronic products for
start-ups, SMEs, and multinationals across multiple industries. At Skylark Lasers Michael drives the
successful development of products, processes, and innovations to provide real value to our
customers.

##### Research Project Manager

##### Mark Mackenzie

Mark holds a PhD in Ultrafast Laser Inscription and Microfluidic Devices from Heriot-Watt
University. Since joining Skylark Lasers in 2018, he has led multidisciplinary R&D programs;
establishing process frameworks that enable consistent prototype-to-production transfer and
successful commercialised outcomes.

##### Head of Engineering

##### Gregor McDowall

With a passion for purpose-led innovation and customer-centric design, Gregor guides the engineering
team towards exciting new developments. Since joining Skylark Lasers, Gregor has been instrumental
in driving our journey towards excellence, and continues to challenge the industry status quo.

##### Head of Hardware

##### Robin Shears

Robin joined Skylark Lasers in 2021, bringing experience in delivering specialised projects from
rocket avionics to quantum sensors. Robin leads the hardware and software team while driving a
'right first time' approach to development, while translating customer requirements into
plug-and-play user experiences.

##### Head of Operations

##### Scott Early

Scott has been the Skylark Lasers head of operations since 2021. With over 10 years of experience in
single frequency laser development and technical management, Scott covers a wide range of roles;
driving operational excellence, nurturing talent, and empowering his teams to succeed.

##### Head of Sales and Marketing

##### Lauren Percy

Lauren is a driven commercial professional with a track record of developing and executing
successful marketing strategies in the deep tech sector, with experience across photonics and the
semiconductor industry. Lauren has a passion for solving commercial challenges and driving
successful business outcomes.

With a commitment to high performance and precision, Solid State Laser serves a global market, providing cutting-edge solutions for both research and commercial use.
relevant_companies.operational_presence: Markets mentioned on website: China

## Laser Cutting Machines

Unique Laser offers advanced **Laser Cutting Machines** engineered for high-speed, high-precision
metal processing. Designed for modern manufacturing environments, our **laser cutting systems**
deliver clean edges, minimal heat-affected zones, and superior accuracy across stainless steel,
carbon steel, brass, and other industrial metals.

Whether you require **sheet metal cutting** or **pipe and tube processing**, a Unique Laser **Laser
Cutting Machine** helps increase productivity, reduce material waste, and lower operational costs.
Featuring advanced **fiber laser technology**, each machine ensures repeatable cutting quality,
faster cycle times, and energy-efficient performance—making it the ideal solution for fabrication,
engineering, automotive, and industrial manufacturing applications.

## Laser Welding Machines

Unique Laser provides advanced **Laser Welding Machines** designed for strong, precise, and
high-speed metal joining applications. Powered by modern **fiber laser technology**, our Laser
Welding Machines deliver deep penetration, clean seams, and minimal heat distortion compared to
traditional welding methods. These machines ensure excellent weld strength, smooth finishing, and
reduced post-processing, making them ideal for demanding industrial production environments.

From portable **hand-held Laser Welding Machines** to fully automated **4-axis Laser Welding
Machines**, our solutions are engineered to meet diverse manufacturing needs. Whether used in sheet
metal fabrication, automotive components, machinery production, or stainless-steel applications,
Unique Laser Welding Machines help improve productivity, reduce operational costs, and maintain

Unique Laser offers advanced **Laser Marking Machine** solutions engineered to deliver permanent,
high-precision marking on a wide range of industrial materials. Using modern **fiber laser
technology**, each **Laser Marking Machine** produces sharp, high-contrast marks with excellent
clarity and durability. These machines are ideal for marking serial numbers, barcodes, QR codes,
logos, batch numbers, and other traceability information required in modern manufacturing.

Designed for speed, accuracy, and low maintenance, every **Laser Marking Machine** ensures
consistent performance even in continuous production environments. With compact designs,
user-friendly operation, and long service life, our Laser Marking Machine systems are widely used in

## Laser Cutting Machines

Unique Laser offers advanced **Laser Cutting Machines** engineered for high-speed, high-precision
metal processing. Designed for modern manufacturing environments, our **laser cutting systems**
deliver clean edges, minimal heat-affected zones, and superior accuracy across stainless steel,
carbon steel, brass, and other industrial metals.

Whether you require **sheet metal cutting** or **pipe and tube processing**, a Unique Laser **Laser
Cutting Machine** helps increase productivity, reduce material waste, and lower operational costs.
Featuring advanced **fiber laser technology**, each machine ensures repeatable cutting quality,
faster cycle times, and energy-efficient performance—making it the ideal solution for fabrication,
engineering, automotive, and industrial manufacturing applications.

## Laser Welding Machines

Unique Laser provides advanced **Laser Welding Machines** designed for strong, precise, and
high-speed metal joining applications. Powered by modern **fiber laser technology**, our Laser
Welding Machines deliver deep penetration, clean seams, and minimal heat distortion compared to
traditional welding methods. These machines ensure excellent weld strength, smooth finishing, and
reduced post-processing, making them ideal for demanding industrial production environments.

From portable **hand-held Laser Welding Machines** to fully automated **4-axis Laser Welding
Machines**, our solutions are engineered to meet diverse manufacturing needs. Whether used in sheet
metal fabrication, automotive components, machinery production, or stainless-steel applications,
Unique Laser Welding Machines help improve productivity, reduce operational costs, and maintain
consistent welding quality with long-term reliability.

## Laser Marking Machine

Unique Laser offers advanced **Laser Marking Machine** solutions engineered to deliver permanent,
high-precision marking on a wide range of industrial materials. Using modern **fiber laser
technology**, each **Laser Marking Machine** produces sharp, high-contrast marks with excellent
clarity and durability. These machines are ideal for marking serial numbers, barcodes, QR codes,
logos, batch numbers, and other traceability information required in modern manufacturing.

Designed for speed, accuracy, and low maintenance, every **Laser Marking Machine** ensures
consistent performance even in continuous production environments. With compact designs,
user-friendly operation, and long service life, our Laser Marking Machine systems are widely used in
automotive, electronics, engineering, medical devices, and industrial component manufacturing.
Unique Laser helps businesses enhance product identification, regulatory compliance, and branding
with reliable and efficient laser marking technology.

## About Unique Laser

**Unique Laser** is a pioneer in laser technology in India, with over **12 years of extensive
experience** in the laser industry, optics, electro-optics, and opto-mechanical equipment
manufacturing. Since its establishment in **2013**, the company has been dedicated to designing and
manufacturing advanced laser machines that deliver precision, reliability, and performance.

We are a professionally managed organization that has successfully supplied **laser marking, laser
engraving, laser cutting, and laser welding solutions** to manufacturers across India, serving a
wide range of industries. Our consistent growth in international markets reflects the trust and
appreciation we have earned from our customers worldwide.

Headquartered in **Vadodara, Gujarat, India**, Unique Laser continues to strengthen its position as
a leading Indian manufacturer of lasers, laser systems, optics, electro-optics, and opto-mechanical
equipment for industrial and research applications.

## Key Features
* The system blends beam – modulation technology to automatically match material thickness with the
power and speed of a rotary index to efficiently transition of tube or pipe cutting.
* The system’s ability to process round, square, rectangle, C-channel and angle iron provides users
with extreme versatility.
* Metal Pipe Fiber Laser Cutting Machine is an example of high-tech flexibility 3D Axis cutting.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Fiber Laser Pipe Cutting Machine used for?
][31]

A Fiber Laser Pipe Cutting Machine is designed for high-precision cutting of metal pipes and tubes
in various shapes, including round, square, rectangular, and special profiles, widely used in
construction, furniture, and industrial fabrication.

What factors affect CNC Fiber Laser Cutting Machine Price?
][32]

CNC Fiber Laser Cutting Machine Price depends on laser power, cutting capacity, machine
configuration, automation level, brand of laser source, and additional features such as bevel
cutting or loading systems.

Is a fiber laser cutting machine 1000W suitable for pipe cutting?
][33]

Yes, a fiber laser cutting machine 1000W is suitable for thin to medium-thickness metal pipes and is
ideal for small workshops or light industrial applications.

How do I choose a reliable fiber laser metal cutting machine manufacturer?
][34]

A trusted fiber laser metal cutting machine manufacturer should offer certified components, stable
machine performance, technical support, customization options, and reliable after-sales service.

What determines fiber laser metal cutting machine price?
][35]

Fiber laser metal cutting machine price is influenced by laser source brand, power range, machine
size, cutting accuracy, control system, and optional accessories like automatic loading and
unloading systems.

## Key Features
* Remote access and pre-alert of maintenance and health of machine reduce downtime of machine.
* Two stage capacitive detect gives sheet angle precision detect and adjust nested sheet
accordingly.
* Vision Cameras helps to monitors the cutting process, pallet exchange and operator console.
* New integrated design incorporating CNC control panel, laser source with the machine.
* Machine compatible with Nesting softwares from Sigmanest ,Lantek and Metallix.
* Production process controlled as per the QR code of the sheet to be processed.
* Magnetic Sheet clamping mechanism secures the sheet while cutting process.
* QR code scanning system to controller helps to retract right parts and design
* To be loaded and avoid mistakes and errors from machine operator.
* UNIQUE LASER machines with ECAT technology are IOT 4.0 ready.
* Dual Pallet exchange speed less than 18 Seconds.
* 6x speed piercing feature for faster production.
* Sheet Auto Detection – Drop Hole Error.
* No sheet underneath or nozzle touch.
* Auto Nozzle Exchanger (Optional).
* Auto Nozzle Cleaner (Optional).
* Nozzle Beam Centring (Optional).
* Slat Conveyor (Optional).
* Six-zone fume extractors.
* Touch Capacitance.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is a fiber laser machine used for?
][26]

A fiber laser machine is used for high-precision metal cutting, welding, and marking applications,
offering high speed, accuracy, low maintenance, and long service life across various industries.

What applications is the Fiber Laser UL 3015 Pro Series suitable for?
][27]

The Fiber Laser UL 3015 Pro Series is designed for high-speed sheet metal cutting in industrial
production, offering advanced automation, IoT 4.0 readiness, dual pallet exchange, and superior
cutting accuracy.

What is the difference between a fiber laser marking machine 20W and 50W?
][28]

A fiber laser marking machine 20W is ideal for light engraving, logos, barcodes, and fine marking,
while a fiber laser marking machine 50W is better suited for deep engraving, fast marking speeds,
and high-volume production.

What is the 20W fiber laser marking machine price based on?
][29]

20W fiber laser marking machine price depends on factors such as laser source brand, marking area,
control system, software features, and optional automation or safety enclosures.

What affects the 50W fiber laser marking machine price?
][30]

50W fiber laser marking machine price is influenced by machine configuration, laser source quality,
engraving depth capability, speed requirements, and after-sales support from the manufacturer.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is the Fiber Laser UL 3015 Lite Series used for?
][33]

The Fiber Laser UL 3015 Lite Series is an industrial fiber laser machine designed for high-speed and
high-precision sheet metal cutting applications.

What is the difference between a fiber laser machine and a fiber laser marking machine 30W?
][34]

A fiber laser machine like the UL 3015 Lite Series is used for metal cutting, while a fiber laser
marking machine 30W is designed for engraving and marking logos, barcodes, and serial numbers on
metal surfaces.

What is the fiber laser marking machine HS code for export?
][35]

The fiber laser marking machine HS code is generally classified under 8456, which covers machine
tools for material processing by laser. Final classification may vary by country customs authority.

What applications is a fiber laser machine 100W suitable for?
][36]

A fiber laser machine 100W is typically used for deep engraving, light cutting of thin metals, and
high-speed industrial marking, offering more power than standard marking machines.

Can a fiber laser marking machine be used alongside the UL 3015 Lite Series?
][37]

Yes. Many manufacturers use a fiber laser marking machine 30W or 100W together with the UL 3015 Lite
Series to handle both cutting and permanent part marking within the same production line.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Fiber Laser Welding Machine used for?
][26]

A Fiber Laser Welding Machine is used for high-precision welding of metals, offering strong weld
seams, minimal deformation, and high efficiency in industrial manufacturing.

How does the laser welding process work?
][27]

The laser welding process uses a focused laser beam to melt and fuse metals together, providing deep
penetration, fast welding speed, and clean, precise joints.

What is the difference between a handheld fiber laser welding machine and an automatic system?
][28]

A handheld fiber laser welding machine offers flexibility and portability for on-site or irregular
welding tasks, while automatic systems like 4-axis machines are ideal for high-precision, repetitive
production.

Is a fiber laser marking machine 30W suitable for welding?
][29]

No. A fiber laser marking machine 30W is designed for engraving and marking, not welding. Welding
applications require higher power machines such as 1000W or above.

What applications is a 1000W handheld fiber laser welding machine suitable for?
][30]

A 1000W handheld fiber laser welding machine is suitable for thin to medium-thickness metals,
maintenance work, fabrication shops, and small-scale production requiring mobility and precision.

What is a Fiber Laser Marking Machine used for?
][35]

A Fiber Laser Marking Machine is used for permanent marking and engraving of text, logos, barcodes,
and designs on metal and selected non-metal materials with high precision and speed.

What is the difference between a fiber laser marking engraving machine and a fiber laser engraving
machine for metal?
][36]

A fiber laser marking engraving machine is used for surface marking and light engraving, while a
fiber laser engraving machine for metal is designed for deeper engraving on materials like stainless
steel, aluminum, brass, and copper.

What are the advantages of a fiber laser marking machine for metal?
][37]

A fiber laser marking machine for metal provides high contrast, permanent marks, minimal heat
impact, fast processing speed, and excellent accuracy, making it ideal for industrial metal marking
applications.

What is a desktop fiber laser marking machine best suited for?
][38]

A desktop fiber laser marking machine is compact and ideal for small workshops, laboratories,
jewelry marking, tool engraving, and low-to-medium production environments.

What industries use fiber laser engraving machines for metal?
][39]

Industries using fiber laser engraving machines for metal include automotive, electronics, medical
devices, hardware tools, jewelry, aerospace, and precision manufacturing.

# Fiber Laser Hand-Held Welding Machine

Portable, fast, and precise laser welding solution.
[Contact Us][21]
[Hendhel Fiber Laser Welding Machine]
[Key Features][22][Samples][23][FAQs][24][Brochure][25]

## Key Features
* The hand-held welding gun replaces the previous fixed optical path, which is more flexible and
convenient, realizes long-distance laser welding, and overcomes the limitation of the travel space
of the workbench.
* The red light is used for positioning, which is used for the calibration of the welding head
position, the welding position is more accurate.
* The laser welding depth is large and the welding Is firm.
* It is not easy to deform, easy to polish and polish, which solves the problems of welding
penetration, welding flash and welding quality caused by argon arc welding.
* It Is used for various complex welds and spot welding of various devices.

## Application Scope

It can be widely used in complex and irregular welding processes in kitchen cabinets and bathrooms,
stairs, shelves, ovens, stainless steel door and window guardrails, distribution boxes, stainless
steel Furniture, and other industries.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is fiber laser welding?
][33]

What is fiber laser welding refers to a welding process that uses a high-energy fiber laser beam to
melt and fuse metals with high precision, deep penetration, fast speed, and minimal heat distortion.

What are the benefits of a hand-held fiber laser welding machine?
][34]

A hand-held fiber laser welding machine provides flexibility, portability, clean weld seams, low
deformation, and easy operation, making it ideal for complex and irregular welding tasks.

What materials can a hand-held fiber laser welding machine weld?
][35]

A hand-held fiber laser welding machine can weld stainless steel, carbon steel, aluminum, brass, and
other metal alloys commonly used in industrial fabrication.

Is hand-held laser welding machine installation complicated?
][36]

Hand-held laser welding machine installation is simple and fast. The system is typically
plug-and-play, requiring only proper power supply, cooling connection, and basic parameter setup.

Where is a hand-held fiber laser welding machine commonly used?
][37]

A hand-held fiber laser welding machine is widely used in kitchen cabinets, stainless steel
furniture, doors and windows, stair railings, electrical enclosures, and metal fabrication
workshops.

## About Us

United Spectrum Instruments (USI) is a specialised provider of advanced scientific and industrial
instrumentation, serving research institutions, high-tech manufacturing, and industrial customers
across India. With a strong focus on precision, reliability, and innovation, we bridge global
technologies with India’s growing research and manufacturing ecosystem. Founded and led by
professionals with deep domain expertise in physics, lasers, and electro-optical engineering, USI
brings over a decade of hands-on experience in supplying, integrating, and supporting world-class
instrumentation. We work closely with globally recognised technology partners to deliver proven
solutions that meet demanding application requirements in India.
[About us usi]

### NEWS AND EVENTS

## What is happening in our industry current updates

#### News

[Acsys news]

#### Precision Day 2025

A large number of guests from industry, research, and business visited Kornwestheim to explore the
latest trends and technological advancements. The event highlighted high‑precision applications,
cutting‑edge automation solutions, and impressive live demonstrations of ACSYS’s newest laser
systems. One of the key attractions was the series of expert presentations delivered by Eric
Gärtner, Max Ernstberger, Dr. Holger Schlüter, and Paulius Bliškevičius, whose deep technical
knowledge and forward‑thinking insights captivated the audience. Lively discussions and extensive
networking throughout the event generated valuable momentum for future projects and collaborations.
[Lasit news]

#### Remadays 2026

LASIT will participate in Remadays, the international printing and advertising trade fair in Poland,
where we will present our latest laser solutions developed specifically for promotional applications
and high‑quality marking on plastic materials. Throughout the event, our technical team will perform
real‑time demonstrations on components provided directly by visitors, offering a clear understanding
of performance, precision, and workflow efficiency. You can find us in Hall F, space 2.36, where we
will share a booth with Inkcups, a recognised leader in pad printing and UV inkjet technologies for
the promotional and industrial sectors. Two fully operational laser systems will be showcased,
allowing attendees to observe live marking on a wide range of materials, shapes, and geometries.

Xcimer is building the world's biggest, brightest and most powerful lasers to commercialize the only scientifically validated form of fusion energy on Earth.

More News

PHOENIX

Xcimer is the most technically mature laser fusion company.

In 2024, we broke ground on our first high-energy laser system, Phoenix. It’s now up and running.

Located in our Denver laser bay, Phoenix features the first electron-beam-pumped excimer laser built in the private sector, and the first of its kind from any organization in more than 20 years.

Phoenix demonstrates long-pulse excimer laser operation (which unlocks cost savings), and a pulse compression technique known as Stimulated Brillouin Scattering (SBS) to shrink microsecond-long excimer laser pulses down to a nanosecond while avoiding all optics damage challenges.

Phoenix is the world's highest-energy use of SBS. It validates key elements of Xcimer's low-cost, high-energy laser fusion architecture. Now we are ready to scale.

ATHENA

Our work on Phoenix builds toward Athena, the world's first laser fusion power plant.

Athena will represent the start of Earth's commercial fusion energy era.

By 2035, we expect Athena to deliver 400 megawatts of safe, clean, affordable energy, around the clock, with fuel derived from seawater and lithium, cost-competitive with fossil fuels and renewables.

Athena is based on the most credible roadmap in fusion, relying on proven science and commercially scalable technologies. Xcimer's power plant architecture bypasses material science and maintenance challenges, resulting in extremely competitive economics.
