## About Eagle Lasers

Eagle Lasers is a high-tech R&D company specializing in advanced fiber laser systems and automation
solutions for sheet metal processing. Our machines are built to empower manufacturers across the
globe through peak-level precision, speed, and reliability with minimal maintenance requirements.
With innovation at the core of our DNA, world-class engineering made in Europe and a solid service
network in the United States, we’re here to fuel your productivity.
[ About Us ][32]

## A Solution For Every Production Need

Eagle Fiber Laser Cutting Systems operate at a superior level of precision and performance. Designed
to meet the demands of today’s fast-paced manufacturing environment, our advanced fiber laser
technology delivers unparalleled cutting speed, accuracy, and efficiency for both thick and thin
materials. All our machine series ensure superior edge quality, reduced maintenance and operational
costs, and increased productivity.

## iNspire 2.0

The iNspire are state-of-the-art fiber laser cutting machines with powers ranging from 4kW to 40kW,
acceleration of up to 6G and cutting speeds up to 150 m/min. Their unique construction with linear
motors on all axes, the eVa cutting head and carbon fiber traverse, achieve unparalleled
performance, making them the fastest laser cutters on the market.

## FlowIN

FlowIN is a breakthrough fiber laser system that sorts at the same speed it cuts, freeing the part
from the skeleton and managing waste without compromising efficiency. It features Eagle distinctive
components such as the eVa cutting head and linear motors, and boasts powers up to 40kW,
acceleration up to 6G and 400m/min positioning speed. FlowIN has no limitations regarding sheet
length and is coil-cutting ready.

## FlowinCO

FlowINCO offers the same functionalities and cutting parameters as FlowIN, but is specifically
engineered for coil-fed sheet metal. By enabling continuous cutting with a steady material feed,
FlowINCO eliminates the downtime resulting in uninterrupted production, scrap-free parts and reduced
material waste.

## eSmart

The eSmart series is designed for trouble-free, reliable production, delivering great results in
little floor space. These sturdy yet compact machines, offer a power range up to 10kW, acceleration
up to 2G and cutting speed up to 100 m/min. They’re the most cost-effective Eagle fiber laser
cutting machines, providing you with efficiency and value.

## eVision

The eVision series is designed for for all-round versatile efficiency, providing optimum results
24/7 whether you run small or large batches, thick or thin sheets. Offering powers from up to 30kW,
acceleration up to 3G, and cutting speeds up to 150 m/min, their great performance and flexibility
makes them the ideal choice for those upgrading from older cutting technologies and looking to to
take their production to the next level.

## Boost Efficiency with Sheet Metal Automation Solutions

Laser cutting automation systems reduce downtime, increase throughput, and optimize your machine’s
performance while providing a safer environment for operators. Eagle Automation delivers intelligent
solutions that adapt to your production needs—whether you’re scaling up, cutting costs, aiming for
24/7 productivity or all three.

## About Eagle Lasers

Eagle Lasers is a high-tech R&D company specializing in advanced fiber laser systems and automation
solutions for sheet metal processing. Our machines are built to empower manufacturers across the
globe through peak-level precision, speed, and reliability with minimal maintenance requirements.
With innovation at the core of our DNA, world-class engineering made in Europe and a solid service
network in the United States, we’re here to fuel your productivity.
[ About Us ][32]

## A Solution For Every Production Need

Eagle Fiber Laser Cutting Systems operate at a superior level of precision and performance. Designed
to meet the demands of today’s fast-paced manufacturing environment, our advanced fiber laser
technology delivers unparalleled cutting speed, accuracy, and efficiency for both thick and thin
materials. All our machine series ensure superior edge quality, reduced maintenance and operational
costs, and increased productivity.

## iNspire 2.0

The iNspire are state-of-the-art fiber laser cutting machines with powers ranging from 4kW to 40kW,
acceleration of up to 6G and cutting speeds up to 150 m/min. Their unique construction with linear
motors on all axes, the eVa cutting head and carbon fiber traverse, achieve unparalleled
performance, making them the fastest laser cutters on the market.

## FlowIN

FlowIN is a breakthrough fiber laser system that sorts at the same speed it cuts, freeing the part
from the skeleton and managing waste without compromising efficiency. It features Eagle distinctive
components such as the eVa cutting head and linear motors, and boasts powers up to 40kW,
acceleration up to 6G and 400m/min positioning speed. FlowIN has no limitations regarding sheet
length and is coil-cutting ready.

## FlowinCO

FlowINCO offers the same functionalities and cutting parameters as FlowIN, but is specifically
engineered for coil-fed sheet metal. By enabling continuous cutting with a steady material feed,
FlowINCO eliminates the downtime resulting in uninterrupted production, scrap-free parts and reduced
material waste.

## eSmart

The eSmart series is designed for trouble-free, reliable production, delivering great results in
little floor space. These sturdy yet compact machines, offer a power range up to 10kW, acceleration
up to 2G and cutting speed up to 100 m/min. They’re the most cost-effective Eagle fiber laser
cutting machines, providing you with efficiency and value.

## eVision

The eVision series is designed for for all-round versatile efficiency, providing optimum results
24/7 whether you run small or large batches, thick or thin sheets. Offering powers from up to 30kW,
acceleration up to 3G, and cutting speeds up to 150 m/min, their great performance and flexibility
makes them the ideal choice for those upgrading from older cutting technologies and looking to to
take their production to the next level.

## Boost Efficiency with Sheet Metal Automation Solutions

Laser cutting automation systems reduce downtime, increase throughput, and optimize your machine’s
performance while providing a safer environment for operators. Eagle Automation delivers intelligent
solutions that adapt to your production needs—whether you’re scaling up, cutting costs, aiming for
24/7 productivity or all three.

## eVa cutting head for the highest fiber laser performance

The cutting head is the most important component of a laser cutting machine since it has to
withstand extreme conditions and be able to control ultra-high powers while maintaining top
precision. Our patented eVa cutting head was built after thorough research to deliver five times
less contamination, with automatic beam centering and minimal service requirements, among other
unique features. The eVa is a state-of-the-art piece of engineering capable of unmatched
performance.

# DESIGNED FOR RESEARCH ENGINEERED FOR INDUSTRY

[CONTACT US][39]
[ 7 ][40]

We are specialists in the design and manufacture of pulsed Nd:YAG lasers, PIV Nd:YAG lasers, DPSS
Nd:YAG, CW Nd:YLF lasers and true TEM00 lasers. 

– Lasers designed for research, engineered for industry.

## DIODE PUMPED LASERS

[][41]

#### [PLASMA and PLASMA +][42]

The Plasma Series high energy are diode pumped, pulsed, high repetition, Q-switched Nd:YAG lasers.
These systems use the very latest in high efficiency fully diode pumped oscillator and amplifier
technology to replace traditional flashlamp pumping.

[][43]

#### [COMPACT][44]

Litron’s extremely versatile and successful compact lasers are stable, robust and rugged. True
flexibility and advanced automated control features allow you to concentrate on your application and
not operating the laser, making them perfect for industrial use.

[][45]

#### [CW HIGH REPETITION RATE][46]

Litron produces a range of high frequency, CW and Q-switched CW diode pumped lasers for a variety of
applications. These are based around both Nd:YAG and Nd:YLF.

[][47]

#### [TUNABLE][48]

Litron’s Aurora laser systems are fully motorised, Type II BBO OPOs pumped by our DPSS Nd:YAG lasers
available in fully integrated or removable modules.

## FLASHLAMP PUMPED LASERS

[][49]

#### [HIGH REPETITION RATE][50]

The LPY series of high repetition pulsed lasers have been designed to suit almost any industrial or
research application. Based around a fully self-supporting invar rail, the LPY series exhibit both
exceptional mechanical and thermal stability.

[][51]

#### [ULTRA HIGH ENERGY][52]

Ultra-high energy pulsed Q-switched Nd:YAG Lasers can provide energies up to 10J at 1064nm. These
rugged, Invar stabilised, pulsed Nd:YAG lasers offer wide capabilities for industrial and scientific
applications.

[][53]

#### [COMPACT][54]

The flashlamp compact lasers are suited to a multitude of applications including LIBS, LIDAR, PIV
and spectroscopy. Sealed against the ingress of moisture and dust, they provide unrivalled
flexibility both in laboratory research and for industrial applications.

[][55]

#### [TUNABLE][56]

Litron’s Aurora laser systems are fully motorised, Type II BBO OPOs pumped by our flashlamp Nd:YAG
lasers available in fully integrated or removable modules.

## CUSTOM SYSTEMS

Litron’s flexible approach and expertise in laser design
means custom lasers are a natural part of our production.
Custom lasers can be either built based on standard modules or,
where necessary, Litron can offer a complete design to fit your needs.

 

[READ MORE][57]

## PIV & Visualisation

Litron Lasers is the acknowledged leader in supplying lasers for PIV applications, ranging from lamp
pumped Nd:YAG lasers in the 15 to 200Hz repetition rates range up to diode pumped Nd:YLF and Nd:YAG
lasers giving kHz repetition rates for high speed applications.

[Details][58]

## Spectroscopy & LIBS

We offer the widest range of laser systems to fit your spectroscopy needs. Our laser systems’ narrow
linewidth enables precise wavelength resolution to be achieved while the high peak powers from
Q-switched lasers enable nonlinear optical phenomena to be investigated.

[Details][59]

## Remote Sensing & LIDAR

Litron’s Q-switched solid-state Nd:YAG lasers provide the necessary high peak powers and repetition
rates.
These are used to obtain meaningful data for applications such as LIDAR, Environmental Monitoring or
Atmospheric Research.

[Details][60]

## Scientific Research

With over 3,000 units working in 33 countries, Litron’s expertise in supporting leading edge science
is second to none. We can deliver systems providing ultra-high energy, high power peaks, wide tuning
range, injection seeding or any combination of features for your research.

[Details][61]

consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

# Home

## **Confidence is Key**

Laser weapon beam diagnostics is our mission.

At SemQuest, we specialize in making innovative hardware that pairs with our innovative software.
Together we provide technology that can go just about anywhere and provide real-time data to help
improve and build confidence in High Energy Laser systems.

Best of all, our equipment is easy to ship, easy to setup, and easy to use.

[Contact Us][17]

### ALIEN

[Learn More][18]

### CaMEO

[Learn More][19]

### BATS

[Learn More][20]

### SLIM

[Learn More][21]

SemQuest enables the testing and evaluation of weapon systems by developing and delivering
technologies that make accurate measurements of military defense systems. We build a wide variety of
high-energy laser target boards as well as state-of-the-art hit detection systems. View our family
of targets flier here.

[SemQuest Family of Targets][22]

# Powerful Software

Our systems ship with state-of-the-art analytics tools for real-time feedback and post-processing.

[Contact Us][23]

# Resilient Hardware

Our systems have been tested in multiple environments. We are able to offer HEL beam diagnostics in
excess of 29 kW/cm².

[Contact Us][24]

# Portable Design

Most of our systems are easy to transfer with all the basic test equipment fitting inside a small
Pelican hard case.

[Contact Us][25]

**Key Features:** Multi-stage loop control, power feedback technology

NPFL series with ultra-high repetition frequency (up to MHz) and single pulse energy up to 100μJ.

# **Laser fusion**
# without limits

## Xcimer is building the world's biggest, brightest and most powerful lasers to commercialize the
## only scientifically validated form of fusion energy on Earth.

[ 06/10/2026 U.S. Department of Energy approves Xcimer’s fusion power plant preconceptual design and
technology roadmap milestone ][20] [ 06/03/2026 Xcimer Energy announces the start of operations for
Phoenix, a prototype system for industrial-scale laser fusion architecture ][21]
[ More News ][22]

## PHOENIX

Xcimer is the most technically mature laser fusion company.

In 2024, we broke ground on our first high-energy laser system, Phoenix. It’s now up and running.

Located in our Denver laser bay, Phoenix features the first electron-beam-pumped excimer laser built
in the private sector, and the first of its kind from any organization in more than 20 years.

Phoenix demonstrates long-pulse excimer laser operation (which unlocks cost savings), and a pulse
compression technique known as Stimulated Brillouin Scattering (SBS) to shrink microsecond-long
excimer laser pulses down to a nanosecond while avoiding all optics damage challenges.

Phoenix is the world's highest-energy use of SBS. It validates key elements of Xcimer's low-cost,
high-energy laser fusion architecture. Now we are ready to scale.

[Technical CAD illustration of Xcimer’s Phoenix high-energy excimer laser system in the Denver laser
bay.]
[Aerial view of Xcimer’s Phoenix laser facility, parking, and surrounding industrial buildings.]

## ATHENA

Our work on Phoenix builds toward Athena, the world's first laser fusion power plant.

Athena will represent the start of Earth's commercial fusion energy era.

By 2035, we expect Athena to deliver 400 megawatts of safe, clean, affordable energy, around the
clock, with fuel derived from seawater and lithium, cost-competitive with fossil fuels and
renewables.

Athena is based on the most credible roadmap in fusion, relying on proven science and commercially
scalable technologies. Xcimer's power plant architecture bypasses material science and maintenance
challenges, resulting in extremely competitive economics.

[Isometric architectural rendering of Athena, Xcimer’s planned commercial laser fusion power plant.]
[Supplemental diagram inset for the Athena fusion power plant visualization.]
[Exterior rear-view architectural rendering of the Athena laser fusion power plant campus.]
[ Learn More About Laser Fusion ][23]

## Read our **detailed roadmap**

Laser-driven inertial fusion is the only fusion approach that has been scientifically proven. Read
our February 2026 white paper with TRUMPF Laser SE to see how our gas excimer laser architecture
makes it economical and scalable.

[Read the white paper][24]

## **Meet the team** commercializing fusion

Nearly 200 engineers, physicists, and business professionals are turning proven science into crucial
technology — with industry-leading execution. Learn about our mission, culture and values.

[Discover Xcimer][25]

## **Fusion:** The ultimate energy source

Our fusion power plants will unlock energy-intensive industries that require firm, abundant,
carbon-free power, from AI training clusters to desalination and industrial decarbonization. Join
the team commercializing the ultimate energy source.

#### **Safe**

No chain reactions, no meltdowns. Fuel is a kind of hydrogen used in watch dials.

#### **Abundant**

Fuel produced from seawater and lithium. Enough fuel for millions of years. No foreign supply
chains. 

#### **Economical**

We’ve designed our system from the ground up to compete on cost with fossil fuels and renewables.

#### **Clean**

No emissions. No pollutants. The only byproducts from our power plants? Helium and heat.

solutions to enable mission-critical space and airborne capabilities.

Laser TechnologIES

## Engineered to enable tomorrow’s missions

Widely recognized as a leader in laser technologies, we utilize a customer- and mission-driven
collaborative design approach to develop cost-effective, high-performance hardware for high-stakes
missions.

### Advanced Lasers

High-power, high-energy lasers that enable first-of-kind mission capabilities spanning precision
targeting and tracking, long-distance ranging, and planetary sensing.

### Lidar Systems

Precision lidar systems for terrestrial and planetary mapping, navigation, and low-size, weight, and
power applications, powered by incorporating the latest laser technology, advanced electronics, and
novel sensing schemes and processing algorithms.

### Optical Communication Terminals

Ground and space domain capabilities for long-range, high-bandwidth communications links are enabled
by Fibertek’s low-size, weight, and power laser communications terminals engineered for
high-reliability beyond low Earth orbit missions.

### Advanced Technologies and Components

Solving tomorrow’s challenges through the development of disruptive technologies in quantum
communications, supercontinuum sources, photonic integrated circuits, laser power beaming, and
advanced electronics for active electro-optic sensing.

# Advancing the mission with laser technologies and engineering services

Our R&D division develops custom, cutting-edge laser, lidar, and optical communications hardware
solutions to enable mission-critical space and airborne capabilities.

[Laser Technologies][29]

Our Engineering Services division provides expert technical staff to enhance scientific research,
testing, logistics, program management, and more for DoD and NASA.

[Engineering Services][30]

Laser TechnologIES

## Engineered to enable tomorrow’s missions

Widely recognized as a leader in laser technologies, we utilize a customer- and mission-driven
collaborative design approach to develop cost-effective, high-performance hardware for high-stakes
missions.

### Advanced Lasers

High-power, high-energy lasers that enable first-of-kind mission capabilities spanning precision
targeting and tracking, long-distance ranging, and planetary sensing.

### Lidar Systems

Precision lidar systems for terrestrial and planetary mapping, navigation, and low-size, weight, and
power applications, powered by incorporating the latest laser technology, advanced electronics, and
novel sensing schemes and processing algorithms.

### Optical Communication Terminals

Ground and space domain capabilities for long-range, high-bandwidth communications links are enabled
by Fibertek’s low-size, weight, and power laser communications terminals engineered for
high-reliability beyond low Earth orbit missions.

### Advanced Technologies and Components

Solving tomorrow’s challenges through the development of disruptive technologies in quantum
communications, supercontinuum sources, photonic integrated circuits, laser power beaming, and
advanced electronics for active electro-optic sensing.

[Find Out More][31]

Engineering Services

## Partners for expert engineering services

A core part of Fibertek’s business since 1996, the Engineering Services division provides Army and
NASA customers with world-class researchers and engineers
* Program Management
* Scientific Research and Analysis
* Budgetary Support
* Logistics Management and Field Service
* Test and Evaluation Support
* Facilities and Warehouse Operations

[Find Out More][32]

Why Fibertek

## A world-class resource for mission-focused organizations

[Learn More][33]

### Unmatched expertise in laser technologies

Our industry-leading number of successful NASA space missions set our foundation for the rapid
development dual use laser systems in support of space exploration as well as national security
missions.

### An agile, customer-driven, collaborative approach

Fibertek demonstrates integrity, streamlined decision making, and a can-do attitude to meet customer
needs swiftly and effectively.

### Solutions for the most demanding missions

We’re solutioning tomorrow’s missions, from space and airborne missile defense to operation through
the extreme cold of lunar permanently shadowed regions and radiation on Mars.

### Excellence in high-stakes environments

We’re a trusted, reliable resource when and where it matters. Whether developing laser technology
for NASA Class A missions or deploying internationally for humanitarian demining, you can depend on
Fibertek.

Careers

## Work on challenging technical problems with a team of like-minded people

At Fibertek, you can make a difference by applying your talents to solve complex problems. As an
independent company, we offer exciting work in support of critical missions. We support you with
uncapped professional growth opportunities, generous pay and benefits, and an attractive
small-business culture that is distinctive among aerospace and defense contractors.

[Centauro]

With this acquisition, Leonardo is consolidating its position as a leading player in the land
defence sector, strengthening its role as an integrated OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) and
shifting from supplying integrated technologies to offering complete platforms, encompassing both
the vehicle and payload components.

**[Press Realease][27]**.

## From vehicle to system

Land defence is one of the cornerstones of integrated security. The sector is undergoing a profound
transformation to counter increasingly sophisticated threats that require rapid response and
technological interoperability. In this context, defence vehicles are interconnected systems that
collect, process and share information in real time.

#### Security across multiple domains

[ [Next card] ][29]

## Security across multiple domains

[DOME-SITOWEB]

In a constantly evolving landscape, the integration of land, air, sea, space and cyber domains
enables operations in complex scenarios by strengthening the link between observation,
decision-making and response. This gives rise to integrated solutions capable of protecting critical
infrastructure and ensuring resilience across all essential sectors. Electronics and digital
technologies act as the glue that securely connects all areas of operation in real time.

Next card

#### Expertise and innovation

[Linea di produzione terrestre_people]

people. These are key factors in sustaining long-term competitiveness and ensuring stability,
strategic autonomy and the protection of communities.

We are a global defence and security company delivering mission-critical solutions that protect
lives and enable operational advantage. We combine deep technical expertise with a bold approach to
innovation—helping our customers solve complex challenges across land, sea, air, space and cyber.

# CONCEPTS TO CAPABILITIES

## OUR PROMISES



###### Priority

We will always prioritize partnering with you to enhance your mission over enhancing our bottom line


###### People

Our employee-owners can be trusted and they trust their teammates to do the “right thing”


###### Culture

We will always endeavor to provide solutions to what others call impossible

## OUR SOLUTIONS

We provide innovative solutions to our customers' greatest challenges. Our customers operate in an
environment where adversaries are constantly evolving and rapidly advancing. Radiance solutions
provide technological advantage and operational superiority for our nation.

### Intelligence


We provide Intelligence analysis and warfighter support to the Intelligence Community and Department
of Defense to enable effective military operations and protect our troops from harm. We specialize
in Intelligence analysis of threat systems across the land, sea, air, space and cyberspace domains.
We use our expertise in engineering, technical data analysis, and exploitation, to help our
customers assess the operational capabilities, performance, effectiveness, and vulnerabilities of
foreign weapon systems and activities.

[Learn more][31]

### Cyber


Radiance applies our cyber capabilities in novel and unique ways to support the Intelligence
Community, armed services, research laboratories, and test ranges. At our founding, we focused on
performing vulnerability and capability assessments of complex weapon systems and their unique
software and hardware. Over the last 20 years, we’ve expanded to include all aspects of cyber
operations with a specialty in systems not covered by traditional cyber methods, tools, and
techniques.

[Learn more][32]

### Directed Energy

 

Directed Energy, including both high energy lasers (HEL) and high power microwave (HPM), has become
one of the U.S. military’s key modernization weapons strategies. Radiance Technologies has been at
the forefront of this directed energy push with our role as developer and integrator of key,
critical technical components, system analytics, propagation, lethality, and live fire operations
and tests. 

[Learn more][33]

### Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning

Extensive background in applying AI/ML techniques to large scale, high throughput sensor data to
extract real time targeting information for the warfighter.  Extensions into deep learning and novel
architectures to address both analysis of big data repositories and time critical information.

[Learn more][34]

### Hypersonics


Since the early 2000s, the DoD has pursued hypersonic weapons development as a part of the
conventional Prompt Global Strike Program. These efforts are accelerating in response to advances of
global peer capabilities. Radiance is proud to be part of the accelerated effort to field both U.S.
capability and counter threat hypersonic systems. We are part of the Army’s effort to field a
land-based hypersonic missile. We also support efforts to understand and counter adversary
capabilities.

[Learn more][35]

### Space


We provide Space solutions and warfighter support to DoD and NASA customers. We use our expertise
in space-based communication, space-based technologies, ISR, and assured PNT to help our customers
deliver solutions and sustaining technologies that give our nation the decisive edge. 

[Learn more][36]

## Employee-Ownership

Radiance is a proud employee-owned company! Employee-ownership has benefits to our customers and
workforce. We are singularly focused on providing our customers with game-changing solutions to
their most challenging requirements.

[Learn More][37]

RP Photonics is an independent and privately owned company. We strive for excellence and great
reliability in the quality of our products and customer service, often taking unconventional and

# Sonic Laser Tech

## About Us

[About Sonic Laser]

As the official Indian distributor of the renowned Raycus brand, Sonic Laser Tech is at the
forefront of delivering advanced laser intelligent equipment and comprehensive technical services.
We specialize in high-performance solutions for laser cutting and laser welding, tailored to meet
the evolving needs of modern industries.

Our commitment to excellence is reflected in every aspect of our work. Backed by a team of seasoned
professionals with deep industry expertise, we ensure our clients receive reliable, efficient, and
innovative support. At Sonic Laser Tech, we don’t just provide equipment — we deliver end-to-end
solutions that empower businesses to achieve precision, productivity, and progress.
* #### [ Robust Technical Support
  #### Why choose us ][5]

We specialize in providing comprehensive pre-sales and after-sales support for Raycus brand lasers,
ensuring your equipment performs at its best throughout its lifecycle. From expert guidance during
the selection process to reliable maintenance and troubleshooting after installation, our team is
committed to keeping your laser systems in optimal condition.
* #### [ Efficient Logistics Services
  #### Why choose us ][6]

With a robust and expansive logistics network throughout Europe, we guarantee fast delivery,
reliable service, and prompt responses tailored to your business needs. Whether it's urgent
shipments or routine deliveries, our streamlined operations ensure your goods arrive on time, every
time.
* #### [ Flexible Leasing Solutions
  #### Why choose us ][7]

We offer tailored leasing and financing services designed to meet your unique operational needs.
Whether you're looking to optimize cash flow, upgrade equipment, or expand your capabilities, our
flexible solutions help you stay agile and financially efficient.

## Our Powerful Services

[48x48x1]

##### [Laser Consulting][8]

Welcome to Sonic Laser Tech, your trusted partner in laser consulting. With years of experience and
a team of industry experts, Sonic Laser Tech is committed to providing comprehensive solutions for
laser technology to our customers. We provide expert advice on Raycus fiber lasers, laser services,
and laser applications.

[48x48x2]

##### [Laser Repair][9]

If your Raycus fiber laser is experiencing issues or requires maintenance, our expert technicians
are here to help. With extensive experience and specialized knowledge, we diagnose and repair a wide
range of problems efficiently—ensuring your machine is back up and running with minimal downtime.

[48x48x3]

##### [Raycus Customer Center][10]

With offices in Surat and Vadodara, Gujarat, India, we are strategically positioned to serve the
growing demand for high-performance fiber laser technology across the Indian market.

[280x200x1]

[280x200x3]

## Applications

[750x500x1]

#### Laser Cutting

Laser cutting is an advanced manufacturing process that employs a high-powered, focused laser beam
to precisely cut through various materials. The laser heats the material to the point where it
melts, burns, vaporizes, or is expelled by a jet of gas, resulting in a clean and accurate edge.
This technique is widely used in industrial applications for cutting metals, plastics, wood, and
composite materials due to its speed, precision, and versatility.

[Read More][11]
[750x500x2]

#### Laser Welding

Laser welding is an advanced technique used to join materials—typically metals or thermoplastics—by
directing a concentrated laser beam at the joint. The high energy density of the focused beam
enables precise control over heat input, resulting in strong, high-quality welds. This method is
valued for its speed, accuracy, and minimal thermal distortion, making it ideal for applications
requiring fine detail and clean finishes.

[Read More][12]

## **We lead the world in high-power lasers for mission-critical directed energy, sensing, and
## advanced manufacturing applications.**

## **The Future of ****High-Power**** Laser Systems.**

For over 25 years, nLIGHT has been at the forefront of semiconductor laser innovation, enabling
next-generation applications once thought impossible. As a pioneering provider of high-power lasers
for mission-critical defense systems and advanced manufacturing, we have built a vertically
integrated technology stack—from semiconductor chips to full laser systems—designed to deliver
unmatched power and performance.

With a portfolio of over 450 patents, nLIGHT continues to push the boundaries of laser power and
precision, ensuring maximum effectiveness across a wide range of evolving threats. Designed,
developed, and manufactured in the United States, our solutions are engineered to safeguard national
security with cutting-edge technology that delivers the highest-power laser on target.

The Group operates in sheet metal working technologies through the Prima Power brand.
A global player providing solutions to businesses of all industries, **Prima Power** offers a
complete range of machinery and integrated solutions, from laser processing to punching and bending,
to flexible manufacturing systems.
 

[The company][16]

[Prima_POWER.png]

## 01.Prima Power

Prima Power provides businesses of all sizes with targeted dynamic technologies that enhance
profitability in sheet metal working.

We create integrated automated solutions designed to meet our clients' challenges and open to their
future growth.

We offer high-performance machines that deliver flexible and precise execution.

Our product range is one of the widest in the industry, covering all stages of the sheet metal
working process: 2D and 3D laser machines, punching and combined punch/laser and punch/shear
machines, press brakes, panel benders, Flexible Manufacturing Systems, and automation.
